gaps.sentence: You will not pass the course unless you ___ all the assignments.
gaps.hint: unless means if not, present simple
gaps.explanation: 'Unless' introduces a negative condition and takes the present simple: complete.

gaps.sentence: If only I ___ more free time these days.
gaps.hint: if only plus past, present wish
gaps.explanation: 'If only' works like 'wish' and takes the past simple for present regrets: had.

gaps.sentence: He wishes he ___ his temper in the meeting yesterday.
gaps.hint: past regret with wish plus past perfect
gaps.explanation: Regret about past behavior takes the past perfect: had not lost.

gaps.sentence: If you ___ me tonight, I will send you the files first thing.
gaps.explanation: A realistic future condition uses the present simple after 'if': email.

gaps.sentence: He would be healthier if he ___ so much red meat.
gaps.hint: an unreal present habit, past simple
gaps.explanation: For an unreal present habit, the if-clause uses the past simple: did not eat.

gaps.sentence: I wish I ___ taller, but genes are genes.
gaps.hint: an impossible present wish with were
gaps.explanation: For impossible present wishes, formal English uses 'were': were.

gaps.sentence: If the battery is completely flat, the engine ___ at all.
gaps.explanation: A permanent characteristic takes the present simple in a zero conditional: does not start.

gaps.sentence: You cannot enter the studio unless you ___ a visitor badge.
gaps.explanation: Rules with 'unless' keep the present simple: wear.
